name: Do Not Give Up
overview: Scripture encourages believers to persevere in faith and good works, assuring them that God’s presence brings lasting joy and fulfillment (Psalms 16:11). Jesus teaches persistent prayer and seeking, promising that those who ask and knock will receive and find (Matthew 7:7; Luke 18:1). Even when human effort seems insufficient, what is impossible for man is possible with God (Luke 18:27), and God works all things together for the good of those who love Him (Romans 8:28). Therefore, believers are exhorted not to grow weary or give up, for in due time they will reap the blessings of faithful endurance (Galatians 6:9).
